pages.text: Beating Hearts are a relatively rare block, only found within $(l:structures/heart_chamber)$(0)$(n)Heart Chambers$(). Depending on their type, they beat on varied intervals and apply a health related effect to all creatures and people in their radius. The type can be changed by using the correct item on it: Ghast Tear for Regeneration, $(l:structures/family_tree#heart)$(0)$(n)Heart Transplant$() for Health Boost, Enchanted Golden Apple for Absorption, $(l:alteration/blood)$(0)$(n)Blood Bucket for Bloodclogged$()
The Coalification can be forcefully spread by amassing Remains, Organic Matter and Bone Meal. Since usual monsters don't appear in it, living in land covered by Coalification can be preferred.
